subject: Creator identity & notification route for monthly bills
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@heliolabs.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Invoices <ap@heliolabs.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 14:12:00 -0400
Subject: Who should create our monthly invoices & how will we receive them?

Hi Jonas,

Quick question as we're lining up our AP cutover next month: who at Redwood will be the canonical creator for invoices billed to Helio Labs (billing entity: Helio Labs, VAT ID ES12345678)? Our AP team needs to know whether Redwood will:

- Create and push invoices directly into our AP portal (preferred for automation),
- Or continue sending a signed PDF + XML by email to ap@heliolabs.com.

Two more constraints:
1) We require a UBL/XML payload for automated posting into our ERP.
2) We need VAT line items broken out — reverse-charge won't apply for all lines, and AP needs a per-line breakdown.

Can you confirm the default flow and whether we can get a sample XML payload/schema and a retention guarantee for invoice PDFs (we keep records for 7 years)?

Thanks,
Marta
Marta Ruiz
Head of Finance Operations
Helio Labs

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@heliolabs.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 09:24:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Who should create our monthly invoices & how will we receive them?

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear list. Long answer short: we can support both approaches, but our recommended production flow for customers with an ERP that consumes XML is:

1) Redwood remains the invoice originator (we issue the invoice on Redwood Inference letterhead).
2) We push a UBL/XML (or your preferred XML variant) and a signed PDF to your AP portal via our portal integration (API push / SFTP) as the canonical delivery.
3) We also send a copy by email to ap@heliolabs.com for manual reconciliation if you want an email fanout.

For the VAT/line-item breakdown — we can include per-line VAT details in the XML and a per-line table in the PDF. For retention: we retain invoice PDFs and XML payloads for 7 years by default for enterprise customers; I will confirm contractual language if you need it in writing.

I've attached our short matrix of invoicing options (redwood_invoicing_options.pdf) and a sample XML schema we typically provide when customers ask (we can adapt it to your ERP). Two questions for you to confirm:
- Preferred transmission: API push into portal vs SFTP drop?
- Do you require our invoices to carry an e-signature cert or is a signed PDF sufficient?

CC'ing Kimberly (billing operations) to scope the portal integration and Ben (collections) for any remittance/PO alignment.

Next steps: if you confirm "portal push + email copy + UBL/XML variant X", Kimberly will send a short onboarding checklist and we'll generate a sample invoice for your AP team to ingest.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: redwood_invoicing_options.pdf (1 page - matrix: push vs email, XML variants, retention)

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@heliolabs.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Invoices <ap@heliolabs.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 11:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Who should create our monthly invoices & how will we receive them?

Hi Jonas — thanks, that sounds good.

Helio preference: portal push is ideal (API push preferred over SFTP). We do need an email copy to ap@heliolabs.com for teams that still reconcile manually.

XML: we use a UBL 2.1-derived variant; attached is our sample loader doc (heliolabs_sample_xml_requirements.xml) with field mapping. Can your schema include:
- per-line VAT_rate and VAT_amount fields,
- seller VAT ID and buyer VAT ID in header,
- PO reference at the line level.

E-signature: a signed PDF is acceptable — we do not require a third-party e-sign cert for the invoice itself as long as the header includes an authorized issuer name and contact.

Retention: 7 years is fine — please include that in the onboarding note.

Could you also confirm our billing contact on file so we can whitelist the portal push sender? Our AP team will need the originating sender + IP range for allowlisting (we'll provide a security contact once we have the final integration plan).

Thanks,
Marta

> On Wed, Jul 11, 2028 at 09:24, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com> wrote:
> > For the VAT/line-item breakdown — we can include per-line VAT details in the XML and a per-line table in the PDF.

Attachment: heliolabs_sample_xml_requirements.xml (sample mapping xsd - 2 pages)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@heliolabs.com>, AP Invoices <ap@heliolabs.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Who should create our monthly invoices & how will we receive them?

Thanks Marta — all good. Finalizing plan and action items below.

Decision: Redwood will be the invoice originator and will push both UBL/XML (UBL 2.1 variant) and a signed PDF to Helio Labs' AP portal via API. We'll also send an email copy to ap@heliolabs.com.

Action items:
- Kimberly: open portal integration ticket, share auth details and sender IP range (ETA 3 business days). Attachment: billing-contact-authority.docx (template for Helio to sign and return).
- Ben: confirm remittance instructions and PO matching rules; add PO reference at line level in our invoice generation pipeline (ETA 5 business days).
- Jonas: generate a sample invoice (XML + PDF) using Helio sample mapping and drop it into the portal sandbox for Helio AP to validate (I'll share the sandbox link and HubSpot record).

Security & allowlist note: once Helio sends the security contact we will provide an IP block and a signed delivery certificate for the API handshake.

Marta — I'll kick off the sample today and expect to have the first sandbox drop by Thu. Will you and your AP team confirm ingestion and let us know if any field mappings need tweaks?

Thanks — cc'ing Kimberly and Ben who will take the ops tasks.

Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: billing-contact-authority.docx (fillable authorization; please return signed)
